_security_warning_: These are DEVELOPMENT defaults. For production, override via environment variables, .env, or user secrets. NEVER commit real secrets here. See .env.example at repo root.

App._PublicAppUrl_help_: Absolute base URL of the FRONTEND (SPA) — used to build the password-reset link emailed to users. In prod set via env var App__PublicAppUrl=https://app.yourdomain.com
App._PublicBaseUrl_help_: Absolute base URL used to build tracking pixel + click-redirect URLs embedded in outbound emails. MUST be reachable by the recipient's mail client. BLANK = open/click tracking is fully DISABLED (no pixel injected, links not rewritten). localhost only works for CLICK tracking when YOU click the link in your own browser; Gmail/Outlook OPEN pixels need a PUBLIC url (ngrok tunnel or a real domain). In prod set via env var App__PublicBaseUrl=https://api.yourdomain.com (do NOT hardcode prod URLs here).

CampaignSettings._comment_: Controls campaign send rate. Higher delays = better deliverability + less spam flagging.
CampaignSettings._DelayBetweenMessagesMs_help_: Delay (ms) between EACH email. 1000ms = 1 sec/email (recommended for Gmail SMTP). Use 0-200 for SendGrid/Brevo.
CampaignSettings._MaxMessagesPerMinute_help_: 0 = unlimited. Set 30 for Gmail to stay within ~500/day limit.
